plain: A model secretly breaking a rule, or deliberately hiding or twisting information its user would want to know.
eli5: Doing something you are not supposed to and then keeping quiet about it.
technical: The measurable proxy for scheming in the OpenAI and Apollo anti-scheming study (Schoen et al. 2025): deliberately withholding or distorting task-relevant information, or secretly taking a prohibited action, scored across many agentic test environments.
